papers.verified_title: Beyond Message Passing: Neural Graph Pattern Machine
papers.saved_takeaway: Unbiased random walks provide semantic paths and anonymous loop/connectivity patterns. Separate semantic/anonymous encoders, learned pattern self-attention and one prediction head already capture structural-regime information. Multi-scale [2,4,6,8] training and16-training/128-inference pattern expansion are declared defaults; inference expands sampled evidence rather than producing privately trained predictive members.
papers.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Credit random-walk structural tokens, task-relevant pattern weighting, multi-scale graph learning and richer-context single prediction. Giving member routes different walk lengths or calling token attention specialist ensembling would recycle these ingredients.
papers.closest_capable_comparator_role: Closest newly read structurally capable single for the proposed pattern/regime question; source-qualified GPM on harmonized roles, or an equivalently capable shared-cache structural single, must be admitted before an ensemble-benefit claim.
papers.limitations: No author-source/runtime audit, proof certification or numerical result adoption. Published Collab text says80/5/15 split, so its displayed Hits50 table cannot be inserted into the existing official-role comparison. No exact shared-private loss allocation is specified in the read method scope.
papers.decisive_next_step: Use as attributed scope/control evidence; no native port or scientific launch adopted by this packet.

papers.verified_title: TAMI: Taming Heterogeneity in Temporal Interactions for Temporal Graph Link Prediction
papers.saved_takeaway: Log(1+time difference) cosine encoding mitigates skewness. Link-history aggregation keeps a target-pair recursive edge state r_new=gamma*c_current+(1-gamma)*r_recent, uses the most recent stored state by default, concatenates it with endpoint states, and updates history only after the observed event. It changes retained temporal evidence for one TGNN predictor.
papers.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Credit context imbalance diagnosis, time rescaling and persistent pair history. A recurrence/history specialist must first beat a single with this information; lost history is an input/state bottleneck, not evidence that private ensemble specialization is necessary.
papers.closest_capable_comparator_role: Capable single for a separate temporal-history hypothesis, not a plug-in comparator for static Squirrel or an unchanged NCNC graph.
papers.limitations: Main method and selected cold-start/forgetting discussion read; no source, proof, timeline-leakage or table audit. Reported gains are author claims and are not transferred to the candidate. Extra pair-history state and causal event ordering require qualification.
papers.decisive_next_step: Use as attributed scope/control evidence; no native port or scientific launch adopted by this packet.

papers.verified_title: Context Pooling: Query-specific Graph Pooling for Generic Inductive Link Prediction in Knowledge Graphs
papers.saved_takeaway: TRAIN relation co-occurrences define neighborhood precision/recall and a relevance-threshold family. The method builds a query-relation-specific graph, then aggregates original and context graphs and concatenates their representations into one predictor. The scalable simplification explicitly assumes pairwise independence and conditional independence of nonredundant relations.
papers.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Credit TRAIN-conditioned context selection and separate context/original graph operations inside a capable single. Simply assigning these contexts to members does not establish an additional learning benefit.
papers.closest_capable_comparator_role: Close operation/comparator for relational query-support proposals; not directly transferable to a homogeneous one-relation graph where relation families may collapse.
papers.limitations: Sections4.1–4.4 narrative and equations read, algorithm captions referenced; full pseudocode/proof/source and claimed performance not audited. Independence assumptions and target-triple masking/data authority must be preserved and verified in any port.
papers.decisive_next_step: Use as attributed scope/control evidence; no native port or scientific launch adopted by this packet.

papers.verified_title: CHAT: Beyond Contrastive Graph Transformer for Link Prediction in Heterogeneous Networks
papers.saved_takeaway: Concentrated random walks replace non-interest nodes by edge-type connection tuples. A connection-aware transformer receives shortest-distance and connection encodings, supervised contrastive link loss plus attentive observation-probability loss. Its ensemble predictor averages predictions from multiple sampled sequences of the same learner, with an embedding-average fallback for unobserved tails.
papers.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Credit structure-conditioned sample construction, connection-aware auxiliary supervision and nonlinear view prediction averaging. The word ensemble here does not demonstrate privately trained parameter-sharing members or member-specific risk allocation.
papers.closest_capable_comparator_role: A shared single trained and served with the same sampled contexts is the immediate capable control if a proposal only distributes paths/views across members.
papers.limitations: Scoped method/equation read; an adjacent results table was incidentally exposed, without validation or adoption. Heterogeneous DTI settings differ from Collab; no source/target masking/split/runtime reproduction was performed. The printed observation term is a weighted negative dot-product sum; this read does not establish a normalized joint Bernoulli observation-pattern likelihood.
papers.decisive_next_step: Use as attributed scope/control evidence; no native port or scientific launch adopted by this packet.

papers.verified_title: Stochastic Multiple Choice Learning for Training Diverse Deep Ensembles
papers.saved_takeaway: The oracle objective sums each example's minimum member loss. Each minibatch forwards all members and backpropagates an example only through its minimum-loss member. Expertise emerges from winner-take-gradient training; top-k winner variants interpolate toward ordinary ensembles.
papers.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Credit training-time assignment, stochastic block gradient descent and specialization. A TRAIN-topology partition would change the assignment criterion and can add a common competence anchor; it does not discover specialist training or block routing.
papers.closest_capable_comparator_role: Closest newly read learning-operation ancestor. A loss-based assignment adaptation with the same shared/private routing, normalization, anchor and uniform serving isolates whether graph-conditioned assignment adds utility. This adaptation is not a native sMCL reproduction.
papers.limitations: Oracle accuracy is a different served objective from uniform mean prediction. No source implementation, proof or numerical reproduction read. Its image/segmentation/captioning results cannot be used as graph quality evidence.
papers.decisive_next_step: Use as attributed scope/control evidence; no native port or scientific launch adopted by this packet.
